description: This file defines an internal interface ICommandInterceptor within a namespace that varies based on compile-time directives, intended for intercepting database commands in different Orleans ADO.NET storage components.

classes.name: ICommandInterceptor
classes.description: An internal interface for intercepting database commands, with a single method Intercept that takes an IDbCommand parameter.

methods.name: Intercept
methods.description: Method intended to intercept and possibly modify or log the provided IDbCommand.
